name: Reliable Warehouse Connectivity via Direct Mode
description: TDS Redirect introduces an opt-in connectivity mode for Fabric Data Warehouse that improves connection reliability by allowing supported SQL clients to establish a direct connection to the Warehouse after the initial handshake. By reducing intermediate proxy hops, this approach delivers more stable and resilient connections, particularly for long-running and stateful workloads such as ETL pipelines and reporting scenarios.TDS Redirect will be first available for workspaces configured with private link service, followed by rest of the workspaces.

result.nameEs: Conectividad fiable con el warehouse mediante modo directo
result.descriptionEs: TDS Redirect es un modo de conexión opcional que, tras el saludo inicial, permite a los clientes SQL compatibles conectarse directamente al warehouse, reduciendo saltos intermedios y mejorando la estabilidad en cargas largas como ETL o informes. Llegará primero a workspaces con Private Link.
